_note: Every admin-web feature-area maps to a Minimal_TypeScript_v7.7.0 template section.
The template lives outside this repo at ~/mesha/mui/Minimal_TypeScript_v7.7.0 (Ravi laptop; licensed source, NOT committed).
Values here are the reference SECTION or PAGE the admin-web area was ported from, so a reviewer
can compare a rendered admin-web page against the template it was built on. `null` means the
area is deliberately Mesha-specific and has no direct template counterpart (Ravi's decision).
check-design-system.mjs asserts every non-dynamic route name in smoke-visual-live.mjs matches
one of the `route_prefixes` here, so a NEW page must add a mapping in the same change.
How to add a page: pick or add the closest template section here; port the section under
components/minimal/<area> or reuse a kit component; write the page.tsx that renders inside
PageShell/DashboardLayout; add a story per state; add the route to smoke-visual-live.mjs so
The Mesha palette is locked. Template gives structure, density, motion, and interaction
patterns only — never its brand colours, images or copy.
